notice: SYNTHETIC RECORDS. Made up by radar/declarations/generate.py from a seed, to show what the radar's restricted layer would do with export declarations. No record is or describes a real declaration, exporter, consignee, forwarder or agent; the ids are made up and look nothing like EORI numbers; there are no names, addresses or postcodes.
house_line: A rise in exports is a lead, not evidence of a breach.

record.title: radar-declaration/1
record.description: SYNTHETIC RECORDS. Made up by radar/declarations/generate.py from a seed, to show what the radar's restricted layer would do with export declarations. No record is or describes a real declaration, exporter, consignee, forwarder or agent; the ids are made up and look nothing like EORI numbers; there are no names, addresses or postcodes.

fields.about: Says what the record is.
fields.synthetic: Always the same text.

fields.about: Every record says it is synthetic.
fields.synthetic: Always true.

fields.about: The declaration's reference. A real declaration has the declarant's own Local Reference Number (DE 2/5) and a reference the system gives it [Likely].
fields.synthetic: SYN-DEC- and a running number; items of one declaration share it.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 2: References of Messages, Document, Certificates and Authorisations

fields.about: The item's number within the declaration.
fields.synthetic: 1, or 2 and 3 on declarations with more items.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 1: Message Information (including Procedure Codes)

fields.about: The date the declaration was accepted. It is the system's date, not a data element the declarant fills in [Likely].
fields.synthetic: A day in the month the shipment is drawn for, 2021 to mid 2026.

fields.about: EX: trade with countries and territories outside the customs territory.
fields.synthetic: Always EX.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 1: Message Information (including Procedure Codes)

fields.about: A: a standard customs declaration for goods that have arrived.
fields.synthetic: Always A.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 1: Message Information (including Procedure Codes)

fields.about: 1040: permanent export or dispatch of Union goods or goods in free circulation and home use. 3171: re-export of non-Union goods previously entered to customs warehousing.
fields.synthetic: 1040 for most items, 3171 for a few.

source.title: Appendix 1: DE 1/10: Requested and Previous Procedure Codes

fields.about: Who exported. A real declaration holds the exporter's EORI number.
fields.synthetic: EXP- and a number. No name or address (DE 3/1) is held.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 3: Parties

fields.about: The party the goods are consigned to. The guidance makes DE 3/10 mandatory where the consignee has a valid GB, EU or XI EORI number or another recognisable reference number; otherwise the consignee's name and address go in DE 3/9. Most consignees in the corridors will have only DE 3/9 [Likely], so a deployment would match consignees on name and address to give each a stable pseudonymous id.
fields.synthetic: CON- and a number, stable for each consignee. No name or address (DE 3/9) is held.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 3: Parties

fields.about: A customs agent declaring for the exporter, where there is one.
fields.synthetic: REP- and a number, or null for self-representation.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 3: Parties

fields.about: 2: direct representation. 3: indirect representation. Left blank for self-representation.
fields.synthetic: 2 or 3 where there is a representative, null otherwise.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 3: Parties

fields.mirrors: DE 3/37 Additional Supply Chain Actor(s) Identification Number, role code FW
fields.about: The freight forwarder, declared as an additional supply chain actor with role code FW (an EORI or a recognised third-country identifier). The guidance says the element is optional and may be left blank, so a real declaration may not carry it.
fields.synthetic: FWD- and a number, or null where none is declared.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 3: Parties

fields.about: The country of destination, as a two-letter country code.
fields.synthetic: Drawn per customer.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 5: Dates, Times, Periods, Places, Countries and Regions

fields.about: The countries the goods are routed through, in order.
fields.synthetic: GB and the destination, with one transit country on some road shipments.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 5: Dates, Times, Periods, Places, Countries and Regions

fields.mirrors: DE 6/14 Commodity Code: Combined Nomenclature Code
fields.about: The first 8 digits of the commodity code from the UK Trade Tariff.
fields.synthetic: The radar's six-digit codes padded with 00 (8548 as 85480000), a few neighbouring codes and some ordinary codes. A real declaration carries the leaf code from the tariff [Certain].

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 6: Goods Identification

fields.about: A plain description of the goods, at most 280 characters.
fields.synthetic: The code's description, the same on every record with that code.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 6: Goods Identification

fields.about: Net mass in kilograms, without packaging; the format allows up to 3 decimal places.
fields.synthetic: From the value and a unit value per kilogram for the code; to 0.1 kg.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 6: Goods Identification

fields.about: The quantity in the unit the commodity code specifies, where the code calls for one.
fields.synthetic: A count of items for the radar's codes, null for the others. Which codes call for units is not modelled [Guessing].

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 6: Goods Identification

fields.about: The statistical value of the item in pounds sterling.
fields.synthetic: Whole pounds.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 8: Other Data Elements (Statistical Data, Guarantees and Tariff Related Data)

fields.mirrors: DE 7/4 Mode of Transport at the Border
fields.about: The mode of transport at the border: 1 sea, 2 rail, 3 road, 4 air, 5 post and so on.
fields.synthetic: Air for most of the radar's goods, road or sea for the rest.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 7: Transport Information (Modes, Means and Equipment)

fields.about: The inland mode of transport, from the same codes; roll on roll-off (6) is not used inland.
fields.synthetic: Road, mostly.

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 7: Transport Information (Modes, Means and Equipment)

fields.mirrors: DE 2/3 Documents produced, certificates and authorisations, additional references
fields.about: Licences, certificates and other documents: a four-character document code, the document's reference and a status code. Export licence codes are listed in Appendix 5C.
fields.synthetic: Made-up codes SYN1 to SYN3, never the real ones, on a few items. The synthetic world does not model which goods need a licence [Certain].

source.title: CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports: Group 2: References of Messages, Document, Certificates and Authorisations

sources_note: Each field mirrors a data element in HMRC's CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Exports; the links are in the repo's private sources file.

columnar_format.about: Columns of equal length, one value per goods item, in order of acceptance date. To rebuild record i: constants hold the fields that are the same on every record; a dict column's value is an index into dictionaries[column]; an int column's value is the value; net_mass_kg is in tenths of a kilogram; supplementary_units holds the count or null; acceptance_date holds the days since the previous record (the first counts from base_date); declaration_ref counts up by one at every record whose goods_item is 1, written as prefix plus a six-digit number; routing is an index into dictionaries.routing; description is descriptions[commodity_code]; documents holds 0 for none or [code index, reference number, status index] into documents.codes and documents.statuses, the reference written as SYN-DOC- plus six digits.
